name: Blanco
source:
The protagonist, Blanco, awakens in an abyss of darkness with no memories. Surrounded by darkness, he wanders through the pitch black forest as far as his feet can take him, with no knowledge of who he is and where he came from.

[Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2018/08/10/vanilla/]Official Site[/url]]
